result.brief: 提出VT-CoRe自监督视频表征学习框架：用三明治采样与Patch Registration Module建立可靠帧间patch对应，并通过自蒸馏潜空间语义对齐与时序变化建模约束表征轨迹，学习结构化潜空间。
result.reason: Self-supervised masked video modeling with patch-level temporal correspondence, latent semantic alignment and self-distillation; directly a video representation learning contribution.
